strengths: Middle '3 Months 2+1 FREE' tier is highlighted and pre-selected with Subscribe & Save 20% ticked.
1 week / 1 month / 2 / 3 / 6 months timeline sets expectations ingredient by ingredient.
UFC 'Hall of Fame' (Tom Aspinall, Carlos Prates) gives borrowed authority for a male audience.
One click from Add to cart to a checkout with Shop Pay, PayPal and G Pay plus a 90-day guarantee strip.
weaknesses: Cookie consent and a store-country pop-up cover the first screen.
Headline is the product name, not the buyer's problem; no mechanism line.
Checkout shows only £69.12 recurring, not the £150 anchor or the saving.
90-day guarantee sits far down the page, not next to the buy button.
